one_liner: Bright Data offers a broad REST API (Web Unlocker, SERP, Web Scraper, Scraper Studio) with self-serve API key auth, a 5,000 credit/month free tier, and an official MCP server with OAuth 2.1.
auth_notes: REST API uses Bearer API key from account settings. Proxy native access uses username/password (Basic-like). OAuth 2.1 is documented only for the MCP server (PKCE, public clients, scope mcp), not the general REST API, so API_KEY is the primary method for a toolkit.
access_notes: New accounts get 5,000 free credits per month with no credit card. The wallet is pre-paid with a hard stop when credits run out. Some products (e.g. Scraper Studio quickstart) mention a payment method on file.
blocker_notes: Usage is credit-metered, but the free tier suffices to build and test.
